sample_warning: Publication-selected public-event proxy; NOT the unbiased distribution of Sectors /v2/filings/.
interpretation: 0.25pp is close to the sample's lower quartile (~0.235pp).
1.0pp is close to the sample median (~0.94pp), but the sample is biased toward newsworthy changes.
Absolute percentage-point thresholds alone miss new positions and large relative changes from a small base.
Final thresholds must be recalibrated on authenticated Sectors filings, ideally 90-120 records, before production/demo lock.
